# ReleaseProof M10 differential fixture

This fictional, synthetic fixture is authored in-repository and contains no customer or mined
GitHub data. The base tree and finite overlays are copied into the digest-pinned fixture runner
image. M10 may select only revisions and mutants declared by the versioned manifest.

The HTTP observation calls the handler contract in-process; it does not open a network socket.
The selected response, state and event fields are sufficient to exercise comparison and masking,
but are not a general web-framework compatibility claim.
